row_definition: ordered triples of solver models for original attempt, retry 1, retry 2; repetition allowed
notes: The kernel Bayesian policy is a dependency-free categorical GP-UCB-like baseline, not a reproduction of AgentOpt Bayesian optimization.
Search policies receive only selected trace cells from the search split; the audit split and answer keys remain evaluator-side.
The coefficients are local proxy prices for an engineering pilot, not provider price claims.
